facts.fact: The Minister of Security, presenting his department's results for 2022-2026 on 2 October 2026, listed the dematerialisation of certain working tools, notably the main courante (occurrence book) and SYGESS, among what has been achieved; the report gives no count of stations using it and does not say how the entry is made.

The dematerialisation of the main courante is presented by the Minister of Security on 2 October 2026 as an achievement of the Ministry of Security itself over 2022-2026; no partner, vendor or source of finance is named.
